pages.text: $(#D2691E)💥 Fire and Ice Symphony · The Art of Explosion ❄$()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B0000)「A searing gamble for immunity to frostbite—this is the madness of snowfield wanderers」$()$(br)The fiery burn of $(#D2691E)dried ginger$() collides with the fury of $(#696969)gunpowder$(), ignited by $(#8B4513)flint sparks$(), while $(#2F4F4F)charcoal$() solidifies the boiling $(#CD5C5C)toxic magma$() into an elixir capable of $(l)resisting both extreme cold and searing heat$().

$(#D2691E)▌ Paradoxical Protection $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)🔥 Lava Skin$()$(br)Even $(#CD5C5C)Nether flames$() feel like a gentle touch.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)❄ Frost Veins$()$(br)Allows one to walk barefoot in a blizzard.$(br2)$(#32CD32)☣ Toxic Consequence $()$(br)$(l)$(#006400)💀 Organ Burn$()$(br)Each breath carries a $(#32CD32)deep emerald pain$().

$(br2)$(#8B4513)▌ Explosive Brewing Process $()$(br)- Smoke $(#D2691E)ginger chunks$() in $(#696969)gunpowder dust$() until they turn $(#8B0000)dark red$().$(br)- Use a $(#8B4513)flint knife$() to scrape $(#2F4F4F)charcoal core$() into $(#000000)blackened crystals$().$(br)- When mixing, it is recommended to wear $(#A9A9A9)iron armor$() and stand $(#00BFFF)upwind$().$(br2)$(#FF0000)⚠$() If the liquid emits a $(#7CFC00)Creeper-like hissing sound$(), evacuate immediately.

$(br2)$(#696969)『 Snowfield Survival Guide 』$()$(br)A tattered page from a wandering merchant’s journal:$(br)'Only those mad enough to drink this $(#D2691E)explosive blood$(),$(br)can hunt $(#4169E1)polar beasts$() bare-chested in the $(#8B0000)lava fields$()—$(br)but know this:$(br)$(#32CD32)every moment of warmth$() must be paid for in $(#006400)internal decay$(),$(br)until the $(#2F4F4F)charred remains of your stomach$() become your final $(#8B4513)badge of honor$().'
